reason: ₹22,000 is more than what I earn in a month, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when my wife and I wash clothes by hand for free. A washing machine is not the first big thing I would spend on, battery or no battery.
objection: Hand-washing costs nothing and we have always done it. Paying more than a month's income, or a big EMI, for something we can do ourselves does not make sense for my household.
would_change_my_mind: A big Diwali or harvest-season offer that brings the price near ₹12,000 with a free gift, on a small EMI I can pay after the crop is sold.
